input.summary: Add mutual 12-month fees liability cap with carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 15.11 waives indirect damages but leaves both Parties' direct liability entirely uncapped, so we have added a mutual cap at twelve months' fees, which is our fallback position. Indemnification and confidentiality breaches, gross negligence and willful misconduct sit outside the cap.

ops.text: Except for each Party's indemnification obligations under Article 12, each Party's breach of its confidentiality obligations under Article 10, and each Party's gross negligence or willful misconduct, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement will not exceed the fees paid or payable under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the claim.
